result.api_summary:
Import from src/game/index.ts.
Run flow:
- `newRun({hero, seed, crownLevel?, profile})` returns a RunState in phase 'rivalCard'.
- `startBattle(run)` moves to 'battle'.
- `battleSetup(run, profile)` returns {config: MatchConfig, rival: RivalDef, botProfileId, botLevel 0..8, looks: [LookId, LookId], battleIndex, battlesTotal, elite, rivalExtras}.
- During play, call `observe(facts, world)` after each step. At the end, `summarise(facts, world, 0)` returns {lines, numbers}.
- `applyBattleResult(run, {won, reason, duration, facts: lines})` moves to 'result'. Then call `recordBattle(profile, run)`.
- `advance(run)` moves to 'draft', 'rivalCard' (rematch, or draft skipped), 'runWon' or 'runLost'.
- In a draft: `offers(run)`, `pick(run, id)`, `reroll(run)` / `canReroll(run)`, `skip(run)`. `abandon(run)` works from any live phase. `counterReason(rivalId, mutationId)` gives the text for a draft card hint.
- When `isOver(run)`: `finishRun(profile, run)` returns {profile, unlocked: UnlockEvent[]}.

Persistence:
- `load(safeStorage(localStorage))` and `save(storage, profile)` never throw.
- `withSavedRun(profile, run | null)` powers Continue.
- `shouldShowHint` / `markHint` handle the FTUE prompts.

Data exports: HEROES, RIVALS, COUNTERS, ARENAS, CROWN_LEVELS, UNLOCK_RULES, STARTING_POOL, PHASE_EDGES. Illegal transitions throw an Error (a wiring bug, never a player action). Settings has the same fields as src/ui Settings, UnlockEvent as UnlockView and TraitIcon as the UI's TraitIcon, so the integrator can pass them through.
fragile_or_unfinished: The sim's crude harness bot ends almost every battle by Throne capture in 14-35 s, far below the GDD's 1.5-2.5 min. The timing ramp and the Crown-based facts are barely exercised until the real src/ai bots are wired in. This should be re-checked with them (it is a sim/AI tuning question, not a game-layer one).

Possible double application with src/ai: BotProfile has `handicapHatchMul` (Bumble and Pip at Crown Level 0) and `levelMutations` (at levels 3 and 6). My battleSetup already applies the handicap through teams[1].hatchMul (first two rivals of the first run) and extra rival Mutations through CROWN_LEVELS (level 2: +1, level 6: +2, Elite and Boss extras). The integrator must use one source for each. I suggest the game layer's, since it builds the MatchConfig. The AI profiles should drop those fields or treat them as documentation only.
`offers` takes only `run`, not `(run, profile)`: the unlocked pool is copied into RunState.pool at newRun, so a reloaded run drafts identically even if the profile changed in between.
recordBattle is not idempotent: calling it twice for one result double-counts telemetry. It must be called once per applyBattleResult.
Codex 'discovered' and Duo recipes 'found' are written only at finishRun (from run.drafts), not live during the run.

Arena layouts pass the geometric rules and build and run in the sim, but no one has looked at them rendered or tested their balance with the real AI. gullet and tinkerworks in particular need bot-sim checks for Throne-rush speed and Tower reach.
facts.observe must be called after every step, including the first. The event-kept critter count was checked against a real count only on meadow with the listed Mutations.
contract_requests: Optional: a per-match `crownHold` (seconds) in MatchConfig would let a Crown Level say 'The Crown needs only 8 s' (GDD section 7 'shorter Crown timer'). Today tuning.match.crownHold is global, so I used 'The Crown opens 15 s earlier' instead.
Optional: export `rand` (or an Rng helper) from src/sim/index.ts so the game layer does not keep its own mulberry32 copy.
src/ai: agree that the game layer owns rival economy handicaps and Crown-Level Mutations (see fragile note), and that botLevel uses the AI's 0..8 scale.
design_decisions: CROWN_LEVELS (cumulative): 1 Sharper (bot level 0 -> 2, then +1 per level up to 8). 2 Armed (+1 rival Mutation). 3 Early Crown (opens 15 s earlier). 4 Elite (the battle before the Boss: +1 Mutation, bot level 8). 5 No Second Look (no reroll). 6 Well Armed (+2 rival Mutations). 7 Mora Ascendant (Boss +2 Mutations, bot level 8). 8 One Crown (1 life). No hidden stat boosts: the rival's hatchMul is never raised.
Rival extra Mutations come from a per-rival ordered list that sharpens its identity. For example, Gorm gets trample, frostbite, militia and Mora gets shockwave, archerHuts, scorch, longArm.

Battle timing: linear from 0:45/1:45 to 1:30/2:30, rounded to 5 s. The Crown phase is always 60 s (the GDD section 3.4 default) and only the open phase grows. Arenas are fixed per rival, although the GDD says 'order and arenas vary'.

First-run handicap is a rival hatchMul of 0.75 for battle 1 and 0.85 for battle 2, only when profile.runs.played === 0. Assist gives the player 1 + assistBonus (at most 0.3) only while settings.assist is on, read at every battleSetup so it can be changed mid-run.
A run counts as played once it has fought at least one battle. Abandoning before the first battle unlocks nothing (this stops unlock farming).

Ladder: rematches use a new seed (mix(seed, battle, attempt)). The draft happens after a win and before the next rival card; during the draft `run.battle` already points at the next rival, so counters target the rival the player can see is next.

Draft algorithm: slot 1 is a random counter to the next rival when the pool has one. Slot 2 is always a Duo when one is offerable, so recipes get found. The remaining slots are weighted toward tags not yet shown (mixed-tag drafts). The order is shuffled. A reroll avoids repeating the current cards when at least 3 others remain. The draft is skipped when 5 Mutations are held or nothing is offerable.

Duo recipes enter the pool through UNLOCK_RULES only after the Mutations that make them meaningful: Cryo Bombs on run 4 (Bombers is in the starting pool), Chain Reaction on run 6 after Splitters on run 3, Bloodrage on run 8, Conscription on run 9. The starting pool already covers all four tags, so 'both tags in pool' is always true; a test enforces it anyway.
Starting pool: bombers, shockwave, bigLitter, militia, frostbite, homing, longArm, rapidFire, trample. It includes at least one counter for every rival.
Warden unlocks on the first run won (Mora beaten). Crown Level n+1 for a hero unlocks by winning at level n when n is that hero's highest level; this is allowed from run 1, not gated behind run 10.
Codex: a Mutation is 'discovered' when first offered, and a Duo recipe is 'found' when first offered. 'best' is the highest Crown Level each rival was beaten at, per hero.

Facts scoring: on a loss, the building margin ('Lost on buildings by just 1') ranks highest, then Crown near-miss, Throne near-miss, 'held out until', takedowns, lead changes and swarm peak. On a win, the win reason comes first, then comeback, stopping their Crown, Throne survived, takedowns, 'never fell' and swarm peak. Lines are 8 words or fewer.

Profile keys follow the UI's Settings names (reduceFlashes, colorMode, showHints). The v0 migration maps the brief's names (reduceFlash, colorBlind, hints) onto them. Storage key: 'kingswarm.profile'. Starting unlocks can never be removed by corrupt data. Telemetry keeps the last 100 runs.

Arena rules as I interpreted them: the 1.2 edge margin applies to centre points (meadow puts an obstacle edge 0.9 from the border). The 'centre line' is x = 16, because meadow's Blue half is x < 16. Obstacle-to-building clearance uses the sim's meadow rule (r + r + captureMargin + hero radius). Obstacles listed in `centre` must come as point-symmetric pairs.
